title: Dispatched at -38°C: Surviving Sub-Zero Lock Freeze-Ups on Western Manitoba Farmlands
summary: When the prairie jet stream dumps Arctic air into southwestern Manitoba, door hardware and combine padlocks lock down solid. Here is how field locksmithing operates when diesel gels and brass shrinks.

title: Anatomy of the Shear Line: Decoding Medeco Biaxial Cylinders & Angular Cuts
summary: A deep dive into Medeco's rotational pin mechanism: how chisel-tip bottom pins interact with a hardened sidebar to create dual-axis physical security.

title: Manitoba Ag Days & Westman Maker Meetup: Modern Farm Security & GPS Anti-Theft Briefing
summary: Recap from our community security presentation in Brandon: how organized rural GPS globe theft is targeting combines across the prairies and how high-security physical locks counter it.

title: Prairie Telemetry: Deploying 915 MHz LoRaWAN Gate Sensors Across 4 Sections of Manitoba Ag Land
summary: How we built and deployed low-power 915 MHz LoRa mesh nodes to monitor remote cattle gates, fuel tanks, and equipment sheds across miles of undulating prairie with zero cellular coverage.

title: Craft Log: Machining Custom 301 High-Yield Picks with Brass Ferrules & Manitoba Walnut
summary: When commercial lock picks lack acoustic feedback and ergonomic grip during marathon bench decoding sessions, you make your own. Here is the machining and finishing process for our bespoke Westman pick set.

title: Bench Restoration: Resurrecting a 1912 Victor Safe 4-Wheel Pack from an Abandoned Prairie Credit Union
summary: Bringing a century-old Victor Safe & Lock Co. cast-iron vault dial mechanism back to life: sonic cleaning, machining replacement brass drive pins, and mathematical wheel decoding.
